entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I need to start a return for an order I placed last month.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the ClubFit Jersey, delivered on October 25th. What seems to be the issue with the item?
The jersey is just the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but this one is just too tight across the chest. I was hoping to exchange it for a large.

I understand. Let me just check our policy for you. One moment... Okay, I see your order was delivered 38 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window, so I can definitely process that for you.
Okay, that's good news. So, you'll send out the large and I'll send this one back?

The simplest way to handle an exchange is for me to process a full refund for the jersey once we receive it. Then you can place a new order for the correct size whenever you're ready. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now.

I see. Well, since I have to go through the hassle of placing a new order and waiting for shipping again, is there any way you could offer a discount code for my next purchase? Maybe 10% off for the inconvenience?

I understand the request, but unfortunately, we don't offer discount codes for sizing issues. I can assure you that once we receive your return, the refund will be processed promptly, within 3 business days.
Alright, worth a shot. A full refund is fine. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. The email with the return label is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you, Sarah.
Have a great day, and thanks again for calling VeloFit.
